name: game-of-life-text-web
description: Browser build of game-of-life-text: TypeScript compiled straight to ES modules, no bundler.

scripts.build: uv run --no-project python scripts/build_web.py && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
